/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import re
p=Path('index.html'); source=p.read_text()
class Check(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.tags=[];self.ids=[];self.uses=[];self.images=[];self.inputs=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs);self.tags.append(tag)
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='use':self.uses.append(a.get('href',''))
  if tag=='img':self.images.append(a.get('src',''))
  if tag=='input':self.inputs.append(a)
c=Check();c.feed(source)
assert c.tags.count('h1')==1
assert c.tags.count('details')==5
assert not [i for i,n in Counter(c.ids).items() if n>1]
assert all(u[1:] in c.ids for u in c.uses)
assert not c.images
assert all(i.get('type')=='email' and 'required' in i for i in c.inputs)
for section in ['features','how-it-works','pricing','faq','start-trial']: assert section in c.ids
for text in ['Northgate Labs','Plinth','Corvid Systems','Halden Bank','Rotation builder','Swaps and overrides','Escalation policies','Handoff notes','Calendar sync','Fairness report','Dana Whitfield','Ravi Menon','Sofia Brandt','99.95% uptime SLA','© 2026 Rotaline, Inc.']:assert text in source,text
assert all(f'max-width:{w}px' in source or f'max-width: {w}px' in source for w in [359,700,850,1100])
scripts=re.findall(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',source,re.S)
Path('/private/tmp/rotaline-page-script.js').write_text('\\n'.join(scripts))
print('PASS: section structure, five native FAQ disclosures, unique IDs, SVG references, required email inputs, supplied content, and responsive breakpoints.')
print('Deliverable:',p.name,'—',p.stat().st_size,'bytes')
PY
node --check /private/tmp/rotaline-page-script.js"
